name: Ishaan Infrastructure & Shelters Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Ishaan Infrastructure & Shelters Ltd is in the real estate business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IISL operates in the infrastructure sector as builders and contractors. Its main objectives are:
a) Construction & Maintenance: Undertake and manage construction and upkeep of buildings, properties, and estates.
b) Acquisition of Property: Acquire lands, buildings, and estates through purchase, lease, or other means.
c) Disposal of Property: Sell, lease, mortgage, or otherwise dispose of owned or acquired properties.
d) Transactional Activities: Buy and sell freehold/leasehold lands, houses, buildings, offices, factories, godowns, farms, etc., for self or clients.
e) Estate Agency Business: Operate as land and estate agents on a commission or non-commission basis.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.05 times its book value
